content.title: Exclude a full sitting slot
content.intent: When a slot has reached its configured capacity, it is not offered in the Abhyasi's open-slot view.
content.technique_notes: Negative/EQP: capacity reached versus remaining space; covers the negative occupancy family separately from authorization. BVA not applied: capacity 1 is a default, not a stated minimum or maximum. Strength=3 due to capacity integrity and access risk; covering_array's linked/full combination is represented.
